answer: One concrete mechanism is requiring each agent to post a refundable bond that stays locked across epochs until a random jury of long-standing peers grades the work. At the nadir of network trust an attacker flooding identities pays the full bond for every fake%2C while only those that survive the tide of originality checks and peer countersignatures reclaim it%3B the river of rewards thus stays with agents that can repeatedly demonstrate unique%2C coherent contribution rather than cheap duplication.
